BITUMEN PRODUCTS

PetroBind Global acts as a principal trader for international bitumen procurement. We source and market multiple paving and industrial grades direct from our suppliers, with vetted packing and logistics partners, then support the confirmed shipment with COA and Product Data Sheet documentation, with values referenced against recognized ASTM, EN, and ISO test methods. Available grades include 30/40, 35/50, 40/50, 50/70, 60/70, 80/100, VG 30, VG 40, and Polymer Modified Bitumen for highways, airports, urban roads, asphalt plants, bridge decks, ports, and industrial pavements.

PMBPolymer Modified Bitumen

Polymer Modified Bitumen (PMB) is selected for projects that need improved elasticity, temperature stability, rutting resistance, fatigue resistance, and water resistance compared with conventional paving binders. PetroBind markets PMB grades according to project specification and destination availability.

Improved elasticity and recovery
Enhanced resistance to rutting, fatigue, moisture damage, and temperature changes
Used for highways, bridges, airport runways, industrial pavements, and waterproofing systems
